2x2 Matrix Addition using Operator Overloading

Problem Statement:
Write a program to overload the + operator to add two 2x2 matrices.

Description:
Create a class Matrix that:
1. Stores a 2x2 integer matrix.
2. Uses constructor to read matrix values.
3. Overloads the + operator to add two matrices.
4. Returns the resultant matrix.
5. Displays the final matrix.

Matrix addition rule:
Result[i][j] = A[i][j] + B[i][j]

Input Format:
8 integers
First 4 integers → Matrix A (row-wise)
Next 4 integers → Matrix B (row-wise)

Output Format:
Resultant 2x2 matrix (each row in new line)
